questions.text: I always use different passwords for each of my accounts.
I never share my passwords with my friends or family.
I always use a combination of numbers, letters and symbols to make a password.
I always read the privacy settings of my social media or applications.
I always think about the negative effect that might happen before posting something on my social media.
I always filter what I would post on social media.
I never click on suspicious links even if they are from people that I know.
I never open a file that has been sent to me by people that I don't know.
I never click on links that are sent to me from people that I don't know.
